relationships.subject: ERβ
relationships.evidence_quote: ERβ also activates the NACHT, LRR and PYD domains-containing protein 3 (NLRP3) inflammasome via caspase-1, increasing IL-1β

relationships.subject: PGE2
relationships.evidence_quote: prostaglandin-E2 (PGE2) stimulates steroidogenic factor-1 (SF-1), enhancing Cytochrome P450 19A1 (CYP19A1; aromatase) expression

relationships.subject: IL-1beta
relationships.evidence_quote: IL-1β and TNF-α reinforce inflammation by upregulating cyclo-oxygenase-2 (COX2) and stimulating PGE2 production

relationships.subject: IL-17A
relationships.evidence_quote: IL-17A, in particular, promotes vascular endothelial growth factor (VEGF) transcription and enhances MMP production

relationships.subject: HIF1-alpha
relationships.evidence_quote: Hypoxia and oxidative stress stabilize hypoxia-inducible factor-1 α (HIF-1α), which cooperates with inflammatory cytokines to induce VEGF-A expression

relationships.subject: HDAC
relationships.evidence_quote: Promoter hypermethylation and histone deacetylase (HDAC)-mediated repression of the progesterone receptor gene reduce progesterone receptor isoform B (PR-B) expression

key_findings: Review: endometriosis-associated infertility arises from hormonal, immune, epigenetic and oxidative disturbances; PGE2/COX-2/aromatase and NLRP3 loops sustain inflammation.
HDAC-mediated repression and promoter methylation of PR drive progesterone resistance; HOXA10 methylation impairs receptivity.
